claim: target-domain-free transfer of the completion module: trained and selected on KITTI-360 alone, evaluated on untouched SemanticKITTI and Occ3D without adaptation. NOT whole-system zero-shot: the frozen foundation models (LingBot-Map, MoGe-2, Trident-H) have not had their training provenance audited, and LingBot-Map's published mixture includes KITTI-360.
change: CompletionUNet convolutions use padding_mode='replicate' instead of 'zeros'. Zero padding manufactured observed=0 AND unobserved=0 at the array boundary -- a state absent from training -- which flooded the grid ceiling. Retrained from scratch on the same data with the same config; thresholds re-selected by the gate's own rule on KITTI-360 drive 0006 only.

rule.checkpoint: highest full-grid occupancy AP on KITTI-360 drive 0006
rule.occupancy_threshold: final-logit threshold maximising full-grid IoU on drive 0006
rule.semantic_threshold: maximises coverage x agreement with the frozen teacher on voxels where both halves of the future window agree; no human semantic label
rule.forbidden: SemanticKITTI and Occ3D/nuScenes are not read

selection.note: selection ran inside a file-access audit; opening a SemanticKITTI / Occ3D / SSCBench-label path would have raised
